audience: First-year calculus learners who know function notation.
learning_objective: Explain and apply the derivative definition while justifying each algebraic transformation and checking the final result.

slide_blueprints.job: Pose a representative problem and identify what makes it difficult.
Expose the reusable method before calculating.
Solve a basic case with every transformation justified.
Solve a contrasting case and call out the decision points.
Compare a correct path with a plausible wrong path.
Turn the worked cases into a checkable procedure.

title: Reasoning from the derivative definition
